items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: For Mr. Fayette? Oh my goodness. Ask me how many times. ... all the children dancing in the yard and things like that for the rich people.

ctx.x: And what other places did you play? Did you play La Louisiane ever?

For Mr. Fayette? Oh my goodness. Ask me how many times. Antoine, Louisiana, St. Charles, Grunewald, Jewish Country Club, New Orleans Country Club, all the children dancing in the yard and things like that for the rich people. Oh my goodness. You couldn't name a place there. I didn't play in New Orleans. Betsy Coles? You couldn't name one place.
I'm going to put you on the spot. What about Betsy Coles? Did you play her La Long Potties?
